message.content: I’m not sure which container you’d like to start. Could you let me know the name (or ID) of the container you want to bring up? If you’re actually looking to start the Docker Desktop service itself, I can help with that too.
message.reasoning:
The user wants to "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker container? Or start Docker service? The phrase "Docker on window" might mean starting Docker Desktop or starting Docker service on Windows. But they mention "docker start". That command starts a stopped container. So maybe they have a container named something and want to start it. But we don't know which container. We need to ask clarifying question. Also we can use the tool to execute commands. But we cannot just blindly run docker start without specifying container name. We should ask what container to start. Alternatively, if they want to start Docker service, we could use "net start com.docker.service" or "Start-Service -Name com.docker.service" via PowerShell. But the user explicitly says "using docker start". So likely they want to start a container.

Thus we should ask: Which container do you want to start? Or do you want to start Docker Desktop? Let's ask clarifying question.
